messages:
marina: quick check — onboarding skyline-13b v1. I see s3://redwood-models/skyline-13b/v1/model.tar.gz but no manifest.json next to it. who uploaded the final tarball?
marina: also noticed tokenizer seems to drop leading spaces: prompts that start with "  summarize:" become misaligned. small smoke perf attached: single A100, seq=512, batch=4 -> p50 230ms, p95 480ms, throughput ~11.8 toks/s. KV warmup spike on the 2nd request (~+80ms).
marina: infra — can someone spin a dedicated small dev pool (redwood-dedicated-small) for a 30m run? want to sweep batch sizes 1/2/4/8 and cold->warm transitions. cc @alex @devon

alex: marina — I uploaded the tarball (will add manifest). path is correct but I accidentally pushed as model.tar.gz instead of model_bundle.tar. patching now. manifest should be at s3://redwood-models/skyline-13b/v1/manifest.json
alex: re: kv warmup: skyline's attentn cache init does extra memcpy on first KV refill — we saw that on other 13Bs, should be ~30-60ms. we'll check kernel selection flags.

devon: tokenizer quirk: skyline was trained with a byte-level pretokenizer + added-space behavior. try inference config: `tokenizer.pad_token='[PAD]'; tokenizer.add_prefix_space=True` for GPT-like prompts. Also set `use_fast=False` if you see off-by-one tokenization differences.
devon: quick snippet that fixed our side:
```
from transformers import AutoTokenizer
tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('skyline-13b', add_prefix_space=True, use_fast=False)
# ensure pad token
if tok.pad_token is None:
    tok.add_special_tokens({'pad_token':'[PAD]'})
```

marina: thanks, testing that now. if add_prefix_space changes token counts, should we pin tokenizer config in the catalog entry?

kaya: yes please pin. catalog expects `tokenizer_config.json` next to weights. add_prefix_space should be explicit. also include `sequence_len_stats.txt` (sample seq length distribution) so serving runtime picks kernel heuristics correctly.

rohan: I can run the 30m loadgen later today. which branch/commit for the runtime? need the flag that disables aggressive continuous batching for the smoke runs.

alex: use `main@perf-sweeps` (rev 7d3b4c). that branch has the batching-slo flag: `--batching-mode=latency-friendly` to reduce preemption.

marina: ran local test with devon's tokenizer fix — leading spaces preserved, token counts match training. quick perf (single A100): batch=1 p50 95ms, batch=4 p50 240ms (consistent). will run larger sweep tomorrow and upload logs.

ci-bot: perf-run queued by rohan. job id: perf-1769501234-01. target: skyline-13b/v1 on redwood-dedicated-small. config: seq=512, warmup=50, samples=500, batches=[1,2,4,8].

deploy-bot: infra note — redwood-dedicated-small has one available node in us-west-2; will reserve for 45m starting 1769505600. reply with :thumbsup: to confirm.

rohan: ack, i'll pick up the run at 1769505600. will capture p50/p95/p99, tok/s, GPU util, and KV cache transition timing.

marina: one last ask — can we add a small test in onboarding checklist that validates `tokenizer.add_prefix_space` parity and checks manifest presence? saves an extra ping next time.

kaya: yes adding checklist item now. also added a quick validator script (catalog/validators/skyline_tokenizer_check) that checks token counts on a small set. i'll push in a sec.

alex: pushed manifest + small note to s3. manifest includes tokenizer_config.json and sequence_len_stats.txt. updating catalog PR with the pinned tokenizer settings.

marina: perfect — thanks everyone. i'll post the perf summary when rohan's run finishes. :sparkles:
